metadata.notes: Manual Copilot generation for stage-3 records; protected source fields were kept unchanged.

word_meaning.meaning_en: a way to enter or reach a place, or the right to use something
word_meaning.meaning_zh: n./v.通道,入径,存取(计算机文件)

word_example.example_en: Students need access to books after class.
word_example.example_zh: 学生课后需要使用书籍的机会。

word_example.example_en: You can access the file with one click.
word_example.example_zh: 你可以点击一次访问这个文件。

word_meaning.meaning_en: easy to reach, use, or understand
word_meaning.meaning_zh: a.可到达的，可接受的，易相处的）

word_example.example_en: The new museum is accessible by subway.
word_example.example_zh: 新博物馆乘地铁就能到达。

word_example.example_en: Her explanation made physics more accessible.
word_example.example_zh: 她的解释让物理更容易理解。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an unexpected event, often causing damage or injury

word_example.example_en: A small accident blocked the road this morning.
word_example.example_zh: 今早一起小事故堵住了道路。

word_example.example_en: He broke the cup by accident yesterday.
word_example.example_zh: 昨天他不小心打碎了杯子。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a place to live or stay, especially for a short time

word_example.example_en: We booked cheap accommodation near the station.
word_example.example_zh: 我们在车站附近预订了便宜的住处。

word_example.example_en: The school offers accommodation for new teachers.
word_example.example_zh: 学校为新老师提供住宿。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to go somewhere with someone or happen together with something

word_example.example_en: Can you accompany me to the hospital tomorrow?
word_example.example_zh: 你明天能陪我去医院吗？

word_example.example_en: Rain often accompanied the strong autumn wind.
word_example.example_zh: 秋天的大风常常伴随着降雨。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to succeed in doing or finishing something

word_example.example_en: We accomplished the project before the final bell.
word_example.example_zh: 我们在最后一声铃响前完成了项目。

word_example.example_en: She accomplished her goal through daily practice.
word_example.example_zh: 她通过每天练习实现了目标。

word_meaning.meaning_en: as stated by or in agreement with

word_example.example_en: According to the map, the lake is north.
word_example.example_zh: 根据地图，湖在北边。

word_example.example_en: According to her note, the meeting changed.
word_example.example_zh: 根据她的便条，会议改期了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a record of money or a description of an event

word_example.example_en: His account of the fire sounded very clear.
word_example.example_zh: 他对火灾的描述听起来很清楚。

word_example.example_en: I checked my bank account after lunch.
word_example.example_zh: 午饭后我查看了我的银行账户。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a person whose job is to keep or check financial records

word_example.example_en: My aunt works as an accountant downtown.
word_example.example_zh: 我姑妈在市中心当会计。

word_example.example_en: The accountant checked every bill with care.
word_example.example_zh: 会计仔细核对了每一张账单。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to collect or grow in number over time

word_example.example_en: Dust can accumulate under the bed quickly.
word_example.example_zh: 灰尘会很快积聚在床底下。

word_example.example_en: She accumulated experience through volunteer work.
word_example.example_zh: 她通过志愿工作积累了经验。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the quality of being correct and exact

word_example.example_en: Speed matters less than accuracy in this test.
word_example.example_zh: 在这次测试中，准确性比速度更重要。

word_example.example_en: The report gained praise for its accuracy.
word_example.example_zh: 这份报告因其准确性而受到称赞。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to say that someone has done something wrong

word_example.example_en: They accused him of breaking the school gate.
word_example.example_zh: 他们指责他弄坏了校门。

word_example.example_en: Never accuse others without clear evidence first.
word_example.example_zh: 没有明确证据前不要指责别人。

word_meaning.meaning_en: familiar with something because it is usual

word_example.example_en: She is accustomed to early morning exercise.
word_example.example_zh: 她习惯了清晨锻炼。

word_example.example_en: We soon became accustomed to the cold wind.
word_example.example_zh: 我们很快就习惯了冷风。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to feel a continuous pain, or a continuous pain itself

word_example.example_en: My legs ache after the long mountain walk.
word_example.example_zh: 长时间爬山后，我的腿很疼。

word_example.example_en: A dull ache stayed in his shoulder.
word_example.example_zh: 他肩膀上一直有一种隐隐的痛。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to reach or gain something through effort

word_example.example_en: Hard work helps students achieve their dreams.
word_example.example_zh: 努力学习帮助学生实现梦想。

word_example.example_en: Our team achieved first place in debate.
word_example.example_zh: 我们队在辩论赛中获得了第一名。

word_meaning.meaning_en: something important that has been done successfully

word_example.example_en: Winning the prize was her greatest achievement.
word_example.example_zh: 赢得这个奖项是她最大的成就。

word_example.example_en: The scientist listed every achievement in order.
word_example.example_zh: 这位科学家按顺序列出了每一项成就。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a substance with a sharp chemical quality, or having that quality

word_example.example_en: Lemon juice has an acid taste.
word_example.example_zh: 柠檬汁有酸味。

word_example.example_en: The lab stored acid in a safe bottle.
word_example.example_zh: 实验室把酸存放在安全的瓶子里。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to admit or accept that something is true or exists

word_example.example_en: He acknowledged his mistake before the class.
word_example.example_zh: 他在全班面前承认了错误。

word_example.example_en: Scientists acknowledge the risks of climate change.
word_example.example_zh: 科学家承认气候变化的风险。

word_meaning.meaning_en: someone you know a little, or knowledge of something

word_example.example_en: He is just an acquaintance from summer camp.
word_example.example_zh: 他只是夏令营里认识的一个熟人。

word_example.example_en: My acquaintance with French is still limited.
word_example.example_zh: 我对法语的了解仍然有限。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to get or learn something through effort or experience

word_example.example_en: Children acquire language through daily practice.
word_example.example_zh: 孩子们通过日常练习习得语言。

word_example.example_en: The museum acquired a rare ancient coin.
word_example.example_zh: 博物馆得到了一枚稀有古币。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the act of getting something or something that has been obtained

word_example.example_en: The library celebrated its latest book acquisition.
word_example.example_zh: 图书馆为最新购入的图书举行了庆祝。

word_example.example_en: Language acquisition needs time and patience.
word_example.example_zh: 语言习得需要时间和耐心。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a unit for measuring land area

word_example.example_en: The farm covers fifty acres of rich land.
word_example.example_zh: 这个农场占地五十英亩肥沃土地。

word_example.example_en: They planted trees across several acres nearby.
word_example.example_zh: 他们在附近几英亩地上种了树。

word_meaning.meaning_en: from one side to the other side of something

word_example.example_en: They ran across the bridge before sunset.
word_example.example_zh: 他们在日落前跑过了那座桥。

word_example.example_en: A smile spread across her tired face.
word_example.example_zh: 一丝微笑浮现在她疲惫的脸上。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a law or action; to perform or behave in a certain way
word_meaning.meaning_zh: n.法令，条例v.（戏）表演，扮演（角色），演出（戏）；行动，做事

word_example.example_en: He can act well in the school play.
word_example.example_zh: 他能在校园剧中表演得很好。

word_example.example_en: We must act fast before the storm arrives.
word_example.example_zh: 在暴风雨到来前我们必须迅速行动。

word_meaning.meaning_en: something done to deal with a problem or achieve a result

word_example.example_en: Quick action saved the child from danger.
word_example.example_zh: 迅速行动让那个孩子脱离了危险。

word_example.example_en: Your action today changed the whole result.
word_example.example_zh: 你今天的行动改变了整个结果。

word_meaning.meaning_en: busy, energetic, and involved in many things

word_example.example_en: She stays active in every class discussion.
word_example.example_zh: 她在每次课堂讨论中都很积极。

word_example.example_en: An active mind asks many useful questions.
word_example.example_zh: 活跃的头脑会提出许多有用的问题。

word_meaning.meaning_en: something that people do for work, study, or fun

word_example.example_en: The club planned a weekend activity outdoors.
word_example.example_zh: 社团计划了一个周末户外活动。

word_example.example_en: Reading is my favorite evening activity now.
word_example.example_zh: 阅读是我现在最喜欢的晚间活动。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a man who performs in plays, films, or television

word_example.example_en: That young actor won praise for his role.
word_example.example_zh: 那位年轻男演员因角色而受到称赞。

word_example.example_en: The actor greeted fans after the show.
word_example.example_zh: 演出结束后，这位男演员向粉丝问好。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a woman who performs in plays, films, or television

word_example.example_en: The actress smiled before the camera began.
word_example.example_zh: 这位女演员在开拍前微笑了。

word_example.example_en: Every actress needs patience during long rehearsals.
word_example.example_zh: 每位女演员在长时间排练中都需要耐心。

word_meaning.meaning_en: real and true, not imagined or guessed

word_example.example_en: The actual cost was lower than expected.
word_example.example_zh: 实际费用比预想的更低。

word_example.example_en: Please tell me the actual reason now.
word_example.example_zh: 请现在告诉我真正的原因。

word_meaning.meaning_en: very serious or sharp; severe and needing quick attention

word_example.example_en: The patient felt acute pain after running.
word_example.example_zh: 跑步后病人感到剧烈疼痛。

word_example.example_en: The town faces an acute water shortage.
word_example.example_zh: 这个城镇正面临严重缺水。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a short form of advertisement

word_example.example_en: I skipped the ad before the video began.
word_example.example_zh: 我在视频开始前跳过了广告。

word_example.example_en: That ad used bright colors and loud music.
word_example.example_zh: 那个广告用了鲜艳的颜色和响亮的音乐。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to change something or change yourself to fit new conditions

word_example.example_en: Animals adapt to cold weather in different ways.
word_example.example_zh: 动物以不同方式适应寒冷天气。

word_example.example_en: The director adapted the novel for film.
word_example.example_zh: 导演把这部小说改编成了电影。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a change made to fit new conditions or a work changed for a new form

word_example.example_en: The film adaptation kept the novel's ending.
word_example.example_zh: 这部电影改编版保留了小说的结局。

word_example.example_en: Human adaptation to heat takes several days.
word_example.example_zh: 人对高温的适应需要几天时间。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to put something together with something else

word_example.example_en: Please add some salt to the soup.
word_example.example_zh: 请往汤里加一些盐。

word_example.example_en: The teacher added one useful point later.
word_example.example_zh: 老师后来又补充了一条有用的观点。

word_meaning.meaning_en: unable to stop doing or using something because you like it too much

word_example.example_en: Some teens become addicted to online games.
word_example.example_zh: 一些青少年会沉迷于网络游戏。

word_example.example_en: He was addicted to collecting old stamps.
word_example.example_zh: 他痴迷于收集旧邮票。

word_meaning.meaning_en: something added, or the process of adding in mathematics

word_example.example_en: The garden needs no further addition this year.
word_example.example_zh: 这个花园今年不需要再增加什么了。

word_example.example_en: Our math lesson focused on simple addition.
word_example.example_zh: 我们的数学课重点讲了简单加法。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the details of where someone lives, or to speak to or deal with something

word_example.example_en: Please write your address on this form.
word_example.example_zh: 请把你的地址写在这张表上。

word_example.example_en: The speaker addressed the crowd with confidence.
word_example.example_zh: 演讲者自信地向人群发表讲话。

word_meaning.meaning_en: enough in quantity or quality for a purpose

word_example.example_en: We have adequate food for the whole trip.
word_example.example_zh: 我们有足够的食物供整趟旅行使用。

word_example.example_en: The room offers adequate space for study.
word_example.example_zh: 这个房间有足够的学习空间。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to change something slightly to make it better or fit

word_example.example_en: You should adjust the seat before driving.
word_example.example_zh: 开车前你应该调整座椅。

word_example.example_en: It took weeks to adjust to dorm life.
word_example.example_zh: 花了几周时间才适应宿舍生活。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a small change made to improve something or the process of becoming used to something

word_example.example_en: A small adjustment improved the machine quickly.
word_example.example_zh: 一个小调整很快改善了机器性能。

word_example.example_en: His adjustment to city life was smooth.
word_example.example_zh: 他对城市生活的适应很顺利。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the management of an organization or the people who manage it

word_example.example_en: The school administration approved the new club.
word_example.example_zh: 学校行政部门批准了这个新社团。

word_example.example_en: Good administration keeps the hospital running well.
word_example.example_zh: 良好的管理让医院运转顺畅。

word_meaning.meaning_en: deserving respect and praise

word_example.example_en: Her admirable courage inspired the whole team.
word_example.example_zh: 她令人钦佩的勇气鼓舞了整个团队。

word_example.example_en: That doctor showed admirable patience with children.
word_example.example_zh: 那位医生对孩子表现出令人敬佩的耐心。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to respect or like someone or something very much

word_example.example_en: Many students admire her calm leadership style.
word_example.example_zh: 许多学生钦佩她冷静的领导风格。

word_example.example_en: I admire the mountain view at dawn.
word_example.example_zh: 我很欣赏黎明时的山景。

word_meaning.meaning_en: permission to enter a place or be accepted into an organization

word_example.example_en: Her admission to college made the family proud.
word_example.example_zh: 她被大学录取让全家都很骄傲。

word_example.example_en: Admission is free for children on Sundays.
word_example.example_zh: 周日儿童可免费入场。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to allow someone to enter, or to say something is true
word_meaning.meaning_zh: vt.承认，准许（入场，入学，入会）

word_example.example_en: He admitted taking the wrong notebook home.
word_example.example_zh: 他承认把错误的笔记本带回了家。

word_example.example_en: The guard admitted us after checking tickets.
word_example.example_zh: 门卫检查票后让我们进入了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the period of life when a person is developing into an adult

word_example.example_en: Adolescence often brings rapid emotional change.
word_example.example_zh: 青春期常常带来迅速的情绪变化。

word_example.example_en: Many habits form during adolescence and remain.
word_example.example_zh: 许多习惯在青春期形成并保留下来。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a young person developing into an adult; relating to that age

word_example.example_en: Every adolescent needs guidance and respect.
word_example.example_zh: 每个青少年都需要引导和尊重。

word_example.example_en: Adolescent health deserves more public attention.
word_example.example_zh: 青少年健康值得更多公众关注。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to take something as your own, or choose to use a method or idea

word_example.example_en: They decided to adopt a homeless dog.
word_example.example_zh: 他们决定收养一只流浪狗。

word_example.example_en: Our class adopted a new study method.
word_example.example_zh: 我们班采用了一种新的学习方法。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to love someone or something very much

word_example.example_en: She adores classical music on rainy nights.
word_example.example_zh: 她在雨夜非常喜欢古典音乐。

word_example.example_en: The little boy adored his brave sister.
word_example.example_zh: 那个小男孩非常爱慕他勇敢的姐姐。
